name: taskbar-claude
description: Unofficial community plugin. Claude battles bugs above the prompt while it works: a smooth animated arena, levels and weapons, with live context, limit and plan readouts.

language.title: Language
language.description: auto follows the language you write to Claude in; tr or en pins one.

sync.title: Sync between computers
sync.description: on turns on sharing the kill count through a private GitHub gist (needs the gh CLI, signed in); the panel's switch can still turn it off.
